한 게임은 10프레임이다. 1~9프레임에서는 프레임마다 공을 최대 두 번: A game is 10 frames. In frames 1 to 9, the ball is thrown at most two times per frame. Knocking down all 10 pins on the first throw is a strike, and that frame ends with one throw. If two throws add up to 10, it is a spare. The score of a strike frame is 10 plus the number of pins knocked down on the next one throw. The score of a spare frame is 10 plus the number of pins knocked down on the next one throw. If it is neither, the score of that frame is the sum of the pins from the two throws. The throws added as a bonus are counted in order from the throws of the later frames (including the extra throws of frame 10). If a strike or a spare comes up in frame 10, more balls are thrown, so the ball is thrown at most three times in frame 10 only, and the score of frame 10 is the sum of the pins knocked down in frame 10. The cumulative score is the sum of the scores from frame 1 through that frame.
